attribution: Zielak (mczielinski), Bitcoin Historical Data, Kaggle v706; normalized historical archive by ff137/bitstamp-btcusd-minute-data.
changes: Selected 2017-2024 UTC. Excluded zero-volume minutes from trade proxies. Aggregated venue OHLCV into session quotes, selected delayed first positive-volume minute opens, summed BTC volume; derived prices, records, charts and dashboard distributed under CC BY-SA 4.0.
limitations: Fixed later vintage, no arrival history, bid/ask, order book, queue position or historical fee tier. An uninterrupted grid does not prove feed uptime.
price_definition: Source minute starts are Unix seconds. Open/high/low/close in USD/BTC, volume in BTC. Open and close use first and last positive-volume minute candle. Delayed execution uses first positive-volume open at or after requested minute. An open is a candle proxy, not a promised fill or trade timestamp.
selection: Eight complete pre-2025 UTC calendar years, 2017-2024, with at least 99% of minute labels per day, valid ordered OHLCV and a positive-volume quote at or after 00:30 every day. No price-return based exclusion.
